summary: From idle to in-use cycles, from a child's bike to full-size models were collected, repaired and refurbished. Each was presented on stage to a student beneficiary of the school.
description: From idle to in-use cycles, from a child's bike to full-size models were collected, repaired and refurbished. Each was presented on stage to a student beneficiary of the school. One each cycle were donated by our Club Rotarians Asha Janardhan and Aditya Sankhla, while Dr G Rameshkumar donated two. The expense of cycle repair was borne by our Club Rotarian Tanuj Lodha, Project Director (Cycle of Joy). At the end of the ceremony, biscuits were distributed to students by our Club Rotarian Yogita Shendge. Present on the occasion were our Club Rotarian Dr Ajay Sati, Yogita Shendge, Asha Janardhan, Ashish Shetty, Tanuj Lodha, Aditya Sankhla, Dr G Rameshkumar. The ceremony was attended in large numbers by students across the school. There was a strong recall as students vividly recalled last year’s cycle distribution. The response was warm and enthusiastic. The school backed the project whole-heartedly. Lasting Impact was created under the 2026-27 Rotary theme, with the club banner on stage.
